name: Sur2f
definition: A hybrid representation for multi-view surface reconstruction that learns two parallel streams: an implicit signed distance field (SDF) and an explicit surrogate surface mesh. It unifies volume rendering of the implicit SDF and surface rendering of the surrogate mesh with a shared neural shader to promote convergence to the same underlying surface.
summary: Sur2f is a hybrid multi-view surface reconstruction method that synchronizes an implicit signed distance field with an explicit surrogate mesh via a shared neural shader to improve rendering efficiency and convergence.
